name: full-page-v1
about: T-183 scene p (the user's add-on: a smooth scroll from the start to the end of the page, full page): load, 2 s at rest, then slow even drags of 560 px in 2000 ms each (finger on the glass, no momentum, plateau ~300 px/s) with 250 ms between them until the page is at its end (y >= 5150 of ~5220), then 1.5 s at rest. Speed fixed here before any capture; same input on both arms. iOS scrolls a G drag itself, like a finger (CAPTURE-DIFFERS, capture README).
